name: smwmusic-battletoads-double-dragon-victory
title: Battletoads & Double Dragon - Victory
description:
Rock tune that could fit as a stage clear theme.
Included also a version that starts with the SMW goal whistle, that you can have by setting "SMW_WHISTLE" to 1 in the txt file (note that not having the whistle will reduce the insert size by a bit).

NOTE: the song uses the samples "0F SMW @21.brr" and "11 SMW @17.brr", so in order for it to work as a global song you'll need to include those in your sample groups (by adding a "!" next to their names in the "Addmusic_sample groups.txt" file, both in #default and #optimized).
